gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.plan.hov: Partial plan: hover missing items for help
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.plan.sou: Missing source in the selected recipe path
recursiveae2patternprovider.configuratio: Enable recursive AE2 pattern generation. When enabled, the mod will automatically generate dependency patterns for missing crafting ingredients
Show the recursive pattern toggle button in the Pattern Encoding Terminal GUI. Default is true

Default setting for allowing item substitutes in auto-generated patterns when parent pattern has no substitute info. When true, allows equivalent items (e.g., different wood types) to be used in recipes
Default setting for allowing fluid substitutes in auto-generated patterns when parent pattern has no substitute info. When true, allows equivalent fluids to be used in recipes
Maximum recursion depth for dependency pattern generation. -1 = no limit, 0 = disable recursion, positive values = max depth
Item required to craft recursive patterns. Use format 'namespace:item_name' (e.g. 'minecraft:iron_ingot', 'minecraft:diamond', 'ae2:calculation_processor')
How many crafting recipes to generate per dependency item. 1 = only the best recipe (recommended)
Ignore recipes that consume their own output (e.g. 'clear settings' / NBT-wipe recipes)
Recipe ids that are never used for auto-generated patterns
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.sco: Filters this pattern only. Other providers can still supply their own routes.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.all: No enabled generated route shown. Supply this item directly or provide a manual pattern.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.not: No eligible crafting route. Supply directly or provide a processing pattern.
Cycle back to an earlier item. Preview stops here.
This item has a pack replacement. Re-encode the pattern or check its exact ingredient.
More routes exist beyond the preview limit.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.lim: Preview is limited. Saved exclusions outside this view are kept.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.hel: Shift-click: toggle recipe. Wheel: zoom. Drag: pan. Always block: remember for new patterns.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.rec: Shift-click or right-click to toggle this recipe throughout this pattern. Blocked routes collapse.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.ite: Click to expand or collapse. Shared ingredients link to their recipes.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.var: Example ingredients only; accepted wood and other variants may differ.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.rul: At most 128 recipe exclusions can be saved on one pattern.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.bra: Recipes did not load. Close and reopen the editor.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.sav: No save confirmation received. Reopen the editor to check the saved choices.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.sta: Pattern changed or session expired. Close and reopen the editor.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.inv: These recipe choices are invalid. Close and reopen the editor.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.err: Could not open the recipe tree. Check the server log.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.too: Configure routes using the recipe tree button in the Pattern Encoding Terminal.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.sha: Shared ingredient. Click to view its recipes.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.def: Defaults for new patterns. Save the tree to keep changes.
Could not read personal defaults. Check the client log.
Pattern saved, but personal defaults could not be saved.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.alw: Blacklisted by default for new recursive patterns.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.com: Compressed route starts collapsed. Expand it to inspect.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.gro: Open Choices to see accepted items together. Recipe variants use < / >. Only one choice is needed per ingredient.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.cho: Click to lock an item. Hover to preview recipes. Save to keep changes.
Click to lock this ingredient. Right-click for JEI recipes.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.pre: No JEI recipe for this item. Supply it directly or provide a processing pattern.
Crafting routes appear when loaded. Install JEI for machine recipe previews.
Preview unavailable. Open JEI recipes to view it.
gui.recursiveae2patternprovider.tree.cho: Cycle: this ingredient leads back to the output.
